parameters.name: acceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:
- zh-CN: Chinese.
- en-US: English.

Default value: zh-CN.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: The keyword for searching resource code or name. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page. Valid values: 0 to 200. Default value: 100.

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: The product code. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
The order in which resource types are returned. Valid values:
- Normal (default): returned in normal order.
- Top: returned in order of popular access.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
The status list for filtering. Valid values:
- Available
- Deprecated

parameters.name: terraformProviderVersion
parameters.description: The Terraform Provider version. If this parameter is left empty, the latest version is used by default.
